title: 1.108.5 (LTS)
excerpt: Tip The lts image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts to stay on the newest LTS patch Verify this release cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.5 Same command for litellm-database , litellm-non_root and the docker.io/litellm/* images What's new in 1.108.5 (LTS) 5 PRs. 4 fixed. No action needed to upgrade Changes OpenAI: Fixed keyless workload identity deployments answering 401 on image edits, audio, files, batches and other routes ( #50962 ) Other providers: Fixed ollama_chat/ streams giving every parallel tool call index 0, so clients ran only the first call ( #50718 ) Messages API: Fixed /v1/messages answering 400 for a param listed in the deployment's additional_drop_params ( #50755 ) Cost tracking and pricing: Fixed incorrect transcription cost for some FLAC files, which could push a key over its budget ( #50860 ) Full changelog
